newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London edge higher.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London edge higher.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London edged higher on Thursday, fuelled by the latest U.S. retail data and a higher Dow Jones Index in the opening.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 161.06 points, or 1.16 percent, at 14,083.75 points.
Earlier the Hang Seng Index in Hong Kong shed 497.18 points, or 3.45 percent, to end at 13,924.34 points as funds were said to unload Hong Kong stocks in the wake of the forthcoming handover.
"With only 20 days to go before the handover, people do get more and more cautious", a trader in London said.
HSBC Holdings were the most actively traded, down HK$ 3.375 to HK$ 228.75. The stock closed at HK$ 227, down HK$ 6 in Hong Kong.
Henderson Land eased HK$ 2.225 to HK$ 65.7, mostly on concerns about local property. Sun Hung Kai Property fell HK$ 2.27 to HK$ 86.8.
Earlier the London Stock Exchange said it will list Chinese mining group Jiangxi Copper Co LTD.
